description: Current measured temperature and target temperature (setpoint) of one room, with setpoint mode, heating demand and open-window state. Identify the room by room_id or room_name.

home_id.description: Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home.

room_name.description: Room name (case- and accent-insensitive). Use room_id or room_name.

name: netatmo_get_room_status

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the home

heating_demand_percent.description: Heat requested by the room valves (demand, not boiler power)

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 date-time with the home UTC offset

setpoint_end.description: When a manual setpoint ends, if reported

setpoint_mode.description: schedule | manual | max | off | away | hg

title: Get current room temperature and setpoint
